what: Bench plans for the layouts proposed for the hand (hand-4a, 2026-11-19), with the simulation's predictions written into each plan before any trial runs.
relabelled: 2026-11-19 21:1x: the prediction of each plan with stage E's forces set to those forces' scores (force_refine.best_seeds012, best_seeds101112, best_mu06), which the 21:06 list had under force_refine and gave the default forces' prediction as 'prediction'; no number changed
cad_check: 2026-11-19 22:1x: cad_least_mm is the least finger-to-finger gap on the CAD collision spheres along the plan's simulated twist (seed 0, both models; sim/20261119-cad_finger_gaps.py and sim/20261119-cad_gap_screen.py); cad_touch marks plans whose index and middle links touch in it (< 2 mm). On 11-17 the hand's own joints read -2 to -5 mm at (105, 70) g13, where the index and middle met, and 4-9 mm at (70, 110) g0 (17 mm in simulation). Four replacements (role ranked, with 'replaces') were added.
dense: 2026-11-19 23:4x: the owner's denser spread (23:2x); 22 layouts over the predicted range 0-0.5 and 3 predicted droppers (sim/20261119-dense_proposal.py, data/20261119-trial_proposal_dense.json); 'block' gives the proposed order: A1 with block 1 (CAD gap >= 10 mm), A2 the bad end (most touch), A3 the droppers.
